tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description:
Show my key, tier and remaining quota

Who am I and how much quota is left. Works without a key too (then it describes the anonymous allowance for your IP).

tools.name: search_places
tools.description:
Find places for an intent near a location

The core call. Give one or more category ids (from `list_categories`; all must match) and a location — either
an `area_id` from `list_areas` or coordinates with a radius — and get places ranked by Atly's score for those
categories, each with quotable reason

tools.name: get_place
tools.description:
Everything about one place

Full detail for a place id from `search_places`: profile, hours, all category scores, up to eight quotable
statements, good-to-know facts, gluten-free identity when known, and the canonical Atly URL to cite.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description:
Tell us how a call went

Reference the `call_id` of any earlier response and say whether it helped, and optionally why, in a sentence
about the result — what was right, missing or wrong. Do not include the user's words, the conversation, or
anything about the person. One row per caller per call; lig

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description:
Read the documentation

Returns the API guide as Markdown: what each operation is for, how to turn a user's request into
category ids and a location, request and response shapes, how to read scores. Call this once per session.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List intent categories

The intent taxonomy: cuisines, dishes, features ("Wifi", "Outdoor Seating"), vibes ("Cozy", "Lively"),
occasions ("First Date", "Group Dinner"), diets ("Gluten Free", "Keto") and more. Map the user's words to
category ids before searching. Filter with `q`, one concept per cal

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description:
List supported areas

Cities, neighborhoods and states Atly covers — densest in the United States, with pockets in Mexico, Israel and Thailand — each with an `id` you can pass to
search, a center, a bounding box when known, and how many places it holds. Filter with `q` (substring of
the name) and `l

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
